sections.content: Take your HTML capstone page and style it completely: layout with Grid/Flexbox, responsive breakpoints, hover/focus states, typography scale, and a dark-mode-ready variable palette.
Checklist: mobile-first, no horizontal scroll at 320px, keyboard focus visible everywhere, prefers-reduced-motion respected, Lighthouse performance >90.
Key points: style mobile first then enhance, test at real device widths, and keep stylesheets organized by component.
Summary: Capstone: Style a Page — practice the example by changing values and predicting the output before running it.

keyTakeaways: Key points: style mobile first then enhance, test at real device widths, and keep stylesheets organized by component.
